tools.name: meta_get_insights
tools.title: meta get insights
tools.description:
Query Meta Ads performance insights. Supports 170+ metrics, 43+ breakdowns with intelligent query planning.
Use meta://metrics resource to see available metrics. Use meta://breakdowns for available breakdowns.
The query planner automatically splits incompatible metric/breakdown combinations into multiple API requests and merges results.

adAccountId.description: Ad account ID (e.g., act_123456789)

level.description: Aggregation level: account, campaign, adset, or ad

metrics.description: Metric keys from meta://metrics (e.g., impressions, spend, ctr)

breakdowns.description: Breakdown keys from meta://breakdowns (e.g., age, gender, country)

timeRange.description: Custom date range with since/until in YYYY-MM-DD format

adIds.description: Restrict ad-level insights to these ad IDs.

attributionMode.description: Use Meta account settings, ad-set settings, or explicitly supplied windows. No setting is inferred from returned numbers.

attributionWindows.description: Only with attributionMode explicit. These windows are sent identically to every split query and account total.

actionReportTime.description: Date basis for actions, sent explicitly to Meta.

includeAccountTotals.description: Also read native account-level totals with the same dates, metrics and attribution. Requires no adIds or breakdowns.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query. Existing MCP Apps fields are returned alongside result.

tools.name: meta_create_adset
tools.title: meta create adset
tools.description: Create a PAUSED Meta ad set with explicit targeting, optimization, placements, attribution, bidding and schedule. Amounts use major account-currency units. Local preview by default. No automatic retry. Account ownership is checked before Meta validation or mutation.

adAccountId.description: Selected owning ad account ID, with or without act_. Every referenced ad object must belong to it.

campaignId.description: Numeric ID of the parent campaign in the selected account. Its budget model and objective determine compatible ad set settings.

name.description: Exact business name to give this object. Do not derive it from an uploaded filename.

targeting.description: Complete Meta targeting spec: geography, demographics, custom audiences, exclusions, placements and targeting_automation. Updates replace the entire targeting spec.

configuration.description: Explicit native Meta ad set settings. First read meta_get_adset_configuration for edits. A supplied targeting object replaces the entire targeting spec.

currency.description: Required with any monetary amount. Must match the actual account currency; never assume EUR.

dailyBudget.description: Daily budget in major account-currency units, e.g. 10 means EUR 10. Cannot be combined with lifetimeBudget or a campaign-owned budget.

lifetimeBudget.description: Total lifetime budget in major account-currency units. Requires an end time; mutually exclusive with dailyBudget.

bidAmount.description: Bid amount in major account-currency units. Only use with a compatible capped bidding strategy.

confirm.description: Apply only when true. Default is a local preview with no API mutation.
